selection_reasoning: These three tasks form a coherent exploration sequence in a desert/mesa-themed environment. The dependency chain is: the player first finds red_sand, which is a natural indicator of a red sandstone biome area. This guides them toward smooth_red_sandstone_stairs (a crafted/placed structure made from red sandstone, which derives from red sand). Finally, black_concrete_powder is placed in a separate but connected area that the player reaches after navigating past the sandstone structures. This creates a multi-hop navigation challenge where each discovery provides spatial/visual cues leading to the next target. All three are 'find' tasks that are observable and verifiable without requiring deep crafting knowledge.

The sandstone stairs structure marks the path toward the black concrete powder placed beyond it

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate to and observe the red sand patch. Red sand is offset from spawn at center (5, -1, 5), approximately 7 blocks away. max_distance=10 requires the player to walk partway toward it (they start ~7 blocks away so they're just within range when facing it). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the red sand, not just passing nearby.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate toward and observe the smooth red sandstone stairs structure. The stairs are at center (11, 0, 5), approximately 12 blocks from spawn. max_distance=8 requires the player to walk at least 4-5 blocks toward the stairs before the milestone triggers. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the stair structure.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must navigate past the stairs to observe the black concrete powder on the gray platform. The concrete powder center is at (16, 0, 5), approximately 17 blocks from spawn. max_distance=8 requires the player to walk at least 9 blocks from spawn (past the stairs) before this can trigger. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the concrete powder blocks.

scene_description: A cleared sandy area with three distinct targets arranged in a linear progression: a red sand patch (3-8 blocks from spawn), smooth red sandstone stairs structure (10-12 blocks from spawn), and black concrete powder on a gray concrete platform (15-17 blocks from spawn). The scene is set in an open desert-like environment with all trees cleared from the play area.
task_text: Explore the sandy area. First, find the red sand patch on the ground. Then locate the smooth red sandstone stairs structure beyond it. Finally, find the black concrete powder blocks on the gray platform at the far end.
design_notes: Scene uses spawn-relative coordinates. Player spawns on regular sand, must walk 3-5 blocks to find red sand, then continue to ~10-12 blocks for stairs, then ~15-17 blocks for concrete powder. All water is explicitly removed to prevent concrete powder conversion. Large air fill (28x28x27) ensures no tree obstructions in play area. Sandstone layer at y=-2 prevents falling through. Gray concrete platform provides visual contrast for black concrete powder.
